desc: A Collector must have, the 3-5-7 Magnum Series features the Model 686 Plus Deluxe with custom black/silver 357 wood grips, unfluted cylinders and is available in three barrel lengths, 3 5 7. Chambered with 7 rounds of .357 Magnum, the all stainless steel Model 686 Plus Deluxe offers compact powerful protection, sport shooting and collecting all in one.
